title: Median function fix
source: synthetic: written for ticket 33 as the thin edge case (4 typed messages); every name and figure is invented

turns.user: This Python function should return the median of a list but it's wrong for even-length lists: def median(xs): xs.sort(); return xs[len(xs)//2]
turns.assistant:
For even lengths you need the mean of the two middle values:

def median(xs):
    xs = sorted(xs)
    n = len(xs)
    mid = n // 2
    return xs[mid] if n % 2 else (xs[mid - 1] + xs[mid]) / 2

turns.user: Before I use it: for [1, 2, 3, 4] it must give 2.5 and for [5, 1, 3] it must give 3.
I ran both in my terminal: 2.5 and 3. Good.
Add a docstring and a test for the empty list.
